welcome.title: OpenDives
welcome.intro: Your dive logbook, on your phone and tablet. How do you want to start?
welcome.existing: I already have a Subsurface account
welcome.existingText: Your dives are backed up in the Subsurface cloud. A copy stays on this device: you can read it without a network, and it is updated when the network is back.
welcome.createText: Free. Your dives are backed up and shared between your phone, your tablet and your computer. You can bring your divelogs.de logbook into it.
welcome.noAccountText: Your dives stay on this device only: no backup, and no sharing with your other devices. You can create an account later and send your logbook to it.

signOut.title: Sign out?
signOut.textNone: The logbook stays in the cloud. A copy stays on this device, not shown, and is used if you sign in again.

textPending.one: {n} change is not sent to the cloud yet. If you sign out anyway, it will be sent the next time you sign in to this account, from this device.
textPending.other: {n} changes are not sent to the cloud yet. If you sign out anyway, they will be sent the next time you sign in to this account, from this device.

signOut.deleteCopy: Also delete the copy on this device
signOut.deleteCopyHint: Possible once the changes are sent
signOut.syncFailed: The changes could not be sent. You are still signed in.
signOut.failed: Signing out did not complete. Nothing was deleted.

consequence.one: The account {email} and its dive will be deleted from the cloud, on all your devices and in every app that uses this account. There is no way to undo it.
consequence.other: The account {email} and its {n} dives will be deleted from the cloud, on all your devices and in every app that uses this account. There is no way to undo it.

deleteAccount.keep: Keep my dives on this device
deleteAccount.keepText: They move to a logbook without account, on this phone only
deleteAccount.export: Export a copy of the logbook
deleteAccount.exportText: A Subsurface file (.ssrf), to keep elsewhere
deleteAccount.passwordText: To confirm that it is you
deleteAccount.note: Changes not sent yet will be synced first, so that the copy kept is complete. The account is only reported deleted if the server confirms it.
deleteAccount.notDeleted: The account was not deleted. Nothing changed.
deleteAccount.wrongPassword: This is not the account's password. Nothing was deleted.

desaturation.title: Desaturation
desaturation.failed: The calculation could not be done.
desaturation.ruleSingle: Recommendation: {hours} hours after a single dive in the day.
desaturation.ruleSeveral: Recommendation: {hours} hours after several dives in the day.
desaturation.atRest: No logbook dive in the last 48 hours: tissues are at rest.
desaturation.chartLabel: Saturation of the 16 compartments, from {min} to {max} % of the limit.
desaturation.chartText: The 16 compartments of the Bühlmann model, fastest to slowest, as in Subsurface's tissue graph: 50 % is the ambient pressure, 100 % the limit (M-value). The colour deepens as the compartment loads, and turns to the alarm colour from 90 %.
desaturation.noDives: No logbook dive counts in this calculation.
desaturation.note: This calculation only knows the dives in the logbook. A missing dive makes it wrong. Your dive computer prevails.
desaturation.recommendation: The wait before flying is an OpenDives recommendation, not a result of the model: 18 hours after several dives in a day, 12 hours after a single one. It is never a guarantee.
